notes.title: 1.4.2 Oculus Touch Motion Controller Support
notes.notes:
[b]- Oculus Touch Controller Support -[/b]
The touch controllers have now been implemented.

[b]- Rumble Feature added -[/b]
Controllers (including VR) will now rumble during appropriate events.

[b]- Tri count optimisation -[/b]
Many meshes have been reduced in polygon count without affecting visuals. The game should now run around 10-25% better depending on your graphics card. Some high poly models were left in the game by mistake. I have now fixed these.

notes.title: 1.4 Patch: Russian, German, French
notes.notes:
There is now a language change door in the main menu room.
Please remember I only understand English (maybe a little German). There may be some mistakes I made when implementing the subtitles. Please do let me know?
Thanks!

- Russian voice acting + subtitles added.
- German subtitles added.
- French subtitles added.

Bug fixes
- Recharge batteries staying inside the charger when rapidly clicking right click button.
- Double clicking recharge button queuing up recharge action (sending you back and forth from the charger).

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards + 1.3 Patch
notes.notes:
Steam Trading Cards are now available!
Collect them to start crafting your Boogeyman 2 badge now.

1.3 
Improvements to the morning scenes after each night.

Nightmare night now has changeable weather. It will rain, snow, thunder, blizzards during different parts of the night... and not 'outside' your window, but within the room itself, getting more difficult as the night progresses.

Ground work was put in place for Russian, German, and French in-game selection options. It's finished. However (It's going through testing, and will be in the next up-date very soon once I'm sure everything is working as it should.)

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 Nightmare Night + Oculus CV1 Support
notes.notes:
1.2

1. Full VR support for CV1 (the shaking was fixed) and the game is now fully supported running at 90FPS using GTX 970.
2. Fixed collision issues with been pushed around on the bed.
3. Fixed collision issues on the main menu in closet.

1.1

1. Nightmare night added.
2. Extra ending scene when nightmare night completed.
3. Special reward in the closet for beating nightmare night.
4. Fixed Night 6 difficulty bug.

Notes:
There were some issues with the Russian version installing for English players. I have disabled the Russian build and will directly implement a language change option in the main menu of the game from now on.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 + 1.02 + Russian voice acting in next update
notes.notes:
1.01

1. Fixed Boogeyman door spawn not firing in later nights. (Yes night 6 + 7 is now harder, sorry. not sorry.)

2. Easter egg for beating the game

3. Subtitles enabled. (Turn off in the pop up menu).

4. Language door changed to credits. (Languages will now be determined by the Steam users profile language instead when booting up the game.)

1.02

1.Fixes night 6 + 7 difficulty spike bug (something was firing a boogeyman spawn more than it should have).

2. Fixed subtitle freeze on night 3

3. Slightly balanced gameplay in all levels. (He now opens the entrances slightly faster.)
